user.title: Connect PSE&G Account
user.description: Easiest: enter the email and password of your MyMeter login (the Email/Password boxes on mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com). Home Assistant signs in by itself whenever the session ends. Use a password you do not use anywhere else. The cookie fields are only for the older paste method and can stay empty.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate PSE&G
reauth_confirm.description: PSE&G needs you to sign in again. Easiest: enter the email and password of your MyMeter login (the Email/Password boxes on mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com). Home Assistant signs in by itself whenever the session ends. Use a password you do not use anywhere else. The cookie fields are only for the older paste method and can stay empty.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PSE&G Connection
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant signs in to PSE&G. Easiest: enter the email and password of your MyMeter login (the Email/Password boxes on mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com). Home Assistant signs in by itself whenever the session ends. Use a password you do not use anywhere else. The cookie fields are only for the older paste method and can stay empty.

error.missing_credentials: Enter your MyMeter email and password.
error.okta_session_invalid: The Okta session cookies provided are expired or invalid.
error.okta_no_session: These Okta cookies cannot sign in on their own. On mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com, use the 'Sign in Via My Account' link (not the email/password boxes), then copy the Cookie header from the id.myaccount.pseg.com /sso/saml request. It should contain idx=.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to PSE&G. Please check your network connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with PSE&G.
error.remember_me_failed: The Portal Cookies contain MM_RememberMe, but MyMeter did not sign in with it on its own. Sign out, sign in again with the Email/Password boxes and Remember Me ON, then copy the Cookie header from a Dashboard request.
error.login_failed: MyMeter did not accept that email/password, or it asked for a captcha or security question. Check the login on mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com in a browser, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This PSE&G account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The provided credentials belong to a different account than the one configured.

reauth_required.title: PSE&G Authentication Required
reauth_required.description: Your PSE&G session has expired. Please re-authenticate under Settings > Devices & Services > PSE&G.

backfill_history.name: Backfill Energy History
backfill_history.description: Fetches historical daily energy consumption and cost from the PSE&G portal and imports them into Home Assistant Long-Term Statistics.

start_date.name: Start Date
start_date.description: The starting date to backfill from (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 2 years ago if left empty.

end_date.name: End Date
end_date.description: The ending date to backfill to (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if left empty.
